# Introduction

This document demonstrates various [[wikilink]] formats.

## Basic Links

Simple link: [[todo]]
Link with display: [[project|My Project]]
Link to section: [[notes#important]]
Complex: [[path/to/note|Custom|additional#section]]

## Lists

1. First item with [[numbered-link-1]]
2. Second item with [[numbered-link-2]]

- Bullet with [[bullet-link-1]]
- Another with [[bullet-link-2|Custom Text]]

## Quotes

> This quote has [[quoted link]]

## Code

Inline code with [[link-in-code]] should still be detected.

```
Code block with [[link-in-block]]
```

## Final

Last link: [[final-link]]
